verdict.rationale: Unity documents WebGL as a first-party build target for publishing real-time interactive 3D graphics into a browser, which covers the 'WebGL today' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence addresses payload size or a WebGPU backend. Missing for 10: evidence of reasonable/optimized web build payload size, any WebGPU support or roadmap, hands-on or independent corroboration of browser deployment quality.

support.subject: As a web developer, my game runs in the browser with a reasonable payload — WebGL today, and a credible WebGPU story

citations.quote: WebGL lets you publish real-time interactive 3D graphics into a browser.
